sections.title: Implementation Rules
sections.text:
Exact eight rules and allowed additions from §9. Compare parsed canonical
structures, never line diff. Diagnostics name rule, operation/error and JSON pointer. Baseline update

sections.title: Validation
sections.text:
Plant and remove all eight deltas: operation removal/path reassignment, response field
removal, required input addition, type change, nullability change, enum removal, error contract drift,
pagination/order reinterpretation. Each exits 1 with exact rule/path. Optional field/operation/enum
addition passes. Snapshot `--check`, root Arch/composer script and CI syntax green.
